title: ProServices weekly sync - risk register & next steps
content:
Date: 2026-04-16
Time: 10:00-10:45 PT
Attendees: Jordan Reyes (owner), Priya Nair (field eng), Liam O'Connor (proservices eng), Zoe Martinez (solutions eng), Marco Liu (security), +5 (silent)
Meeting objective: Weekly catch-up to align on customer integration progress, surface blockers, update the risk register, and confirm owners for next-week actions.

1) Quick summary (2-minute roast)
- 4 active integrations in rollout (AlphaCorp, BetaHealth, GammaRetail, DeltaBank).
- Two customer timelines slipped vs original commitments; cause split between infra (HSM/keys) and model-quality regression after quantized rollout.
- Canary for dedicated pool v3 passed 3/4 throughput tests but exposed a memory leak case under long-tail sequences. Patch in review.

2) Per-customer status (condensed)
- AlphaCorp (SaaS analytics vendor)
  - Current: On private deployment in staging; SSO mapping returns inconsistent roles for nested groups (edge case).
  - Impact: Blocks production cutover.
  - Root cause hypothesis: IDP group mapping + role mapping mismatch surfaced after new token caching landed in runtime (KV cache change).
  - Tickets: INTG-1458 (SSO role mapping), PR #872 (cache-change revert candidate).
  - Actions: Priya to own hotfix revert test (due 2026-04-18). Jordan to schedule roll-forward window with AlphaCorp for 4/19.

- BetaHealth (regulated healthcare customer)
  - Current: Private deployment, pending HSM integration and KMS policy approval.
  - Impact: Cannot proceed to acceptance testing until key rotation flow validated and penetration test re-signed off.
  - Notes: Security flagged HSM vendor cert expiry in staging; Marco coordinating vendor contact.
  - Actions: Marco to confirm HSM cert timeline and provide mitigation by 2026-04-20. Liam to draft temporary rollback plan for keys by 2026-04-19.

- GammaRetail (e‑commerce partner)
  - Current: Hosted API plan; Canary rollout of quantized 4-bit variant showed small but measurable drops in accuracy on price-normalization prompts.
  - Impact: Decision paused for wider customer test set.
  - Diagnostics: Evaluation harness shows ~3.2% F1 drift on enrichment tasks when context length >1k tokens. Suspect tokenization mismatch + quantization tail effects.
  - Actions: Zoe to run targeted eval with expanded prompt set and send results 2026-04-18. If drift <2% will resume canary. Jordan to notify GammaRetail of hold and expectation window.

- DeltaBank (financial services pilot)
  - Current: Compliance review almost complete; last item is audit logging format that must be WORM-compatible.
  - Impact: Minor; expected sign-off next week once log schema updated.
  - Actions: Liam will update audit-logs schema and surface sample logs by 2026-04-19.

3) Risk register (new + elevated)
- R1: Token cache change causes RBAC/SSO mismatches (Severity: High)
  - Evidence: AlphaCorp errors and INTG-1458.
  - Mitigation: Revert patch in staging; create fallback mapping and add integration test for nested groups. Owner: Priya. ETA: 2026-04-18.
- R2: HSM vendor certificate expiry (Severity: High)
  - Evidence: BetaHealth staging cert flagged.
  - Mitigation: Vendor engagement, temporary policy to accept short-term cert, expedited rotation. Owner: Marco. ETA: 2026-04-20.
- R3: Quantized model accuracy regression on long contexts (Severity: Medium)
  - Evidence: GammaRetail canary metrics.
  - Mitigation: Expanded eval suite, increase fp fallback threshold for problem prompts, consider 6-bit quant version for this workload. Owner: Zoe. ETA: 2026-04-22.
- R4: Memory leak in dedicated-pool v3 under long-tail sequences (Severity: Medium)
  - Evidence: Canary throughput test and OOM traces.
  - Mitigation: Patch in PR review; add stress test in release pipeline. Owner: Jordan. ETA: 2026-04-21.

4) Decisions taken in meeting
- Opened canary hold for GammaRetail until Zoe's eval returns; will not roll forward without <2% drift target.
- Fast-revert approach agreed for the KV cache change affecting SSO; testing on AlphaCorp staging will be first priority.
- Temporary acceptance for BetaHealth: allow short-lived cert if vendor confirms rotation path; legal to sign off emergency exception once Marco provides timeline.

5) Action items (owner — due — acceptance criteria)
- Priya — 2026-04-18 — Run staging revert, validate SSO mapping for nested groups, post results to INTG-1458 and update playbook confluence page.
- Jordan — 2026-04-19 — Coordinate AlphaCorp roll window for revert + retest; confirm stakeholders and contingency plan.
- Marco — 2026-04-20 — Vendor cert confirmation + emergency rotation plan; escalate to legal if timeline >7 days.
- Liam — 2026-04-19 — Draft key-rotation rollback plan for BetaHealth and validate with security.
- Zoe — 2026-04-18 — Expanded eval for GammaRetail prompts (long contexts); publish metrics and recommendation (resume canary / hold / fallback).
- Jordan — 2026-04-21 — Merge memory-leak patch after bench validation; add stress test to pipeline.

6) Operational notes / follow-ups for platform
- Observability gap: Private deployments currently lack token-level latency breakdown in K8s sidecar logs — SRE to prioritize small instrumentation change next sprint.
- Autoscaler: Dedicated pool v3 autoscaling config needs a lower threshold for tail latency; Doug (SRE) to propose config by 4/23.
- Canary metrics dashboard: Add accuracy-by-prompt-type chart to make GammaRetail decisions faster. Product to approve UI scope.

7) Questions / open items
- Do we want to add an automatic fallback to pre-quantized model for customers with custom prompt sets? (Product / Research input required.)
- Should we codify emergency cert acceptance policy for regulated customers? (Legal + Security)

8) Next meeting
- Time: 2026-04-23 10:00 PT
- Focus: Verify action item statuses, AlphaCorp staging validation, HSM cert outcome, GammaRetail eval results.

Notes / misc
- Quick references: INTG-1458 contains AlphaCorp logs; PR #872 is revert candidate for KV cache. Confluence onboarding playbook to be updated with new SSO validation step.
- Tone: keep customers informed but avoid promising dates until staging validation completes.

Document author: Jordan Reyes
Document version: 0.2 (working)

End of note.
